result.instructions: Tools for Nozbe Teams, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tasks in my Nozbe projects are due this week?"; "List all active tasks assigned to me in the Marketing project."; "Add a task 'Prepare Q1 report' to the Finance project and assign it to me.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nozbe Teams data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nozbeteams_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nozbeteams_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nozbeteams_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nozbeteams_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nozbeteams_list_teams
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List the Nozbe spaces (teams) the token can see, with plan info. Good first call. API: GET /teams.

offset.description: Number of objects to skip (for paging).

sortBy.description: Sort fields separated by commas; '-' prefix = descending, e.g. '-created_at'.

fields.description: Only return these fields, separated by commas, e.g. 'id,name'.

tools.name: nozbeteams_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task. Without project_id the task goes to the Single Actions project of the token owner. Use responsible_id 'author' to assign it to the token owner. Not retried on failure. API: POST /tasks.

responsible_id.description: User id to assign, or 'author' for the token owner.

due_at.description: Due date and time, Unix milliseconds.

is_all_day.description: true = due date has no time.

tools.name: nozbeteams_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a task. Set ended_at to a Unix ms time to complete the task. Only the fields you pass change. API: PUT /tasks/{id}.

project_id.description: Move the task to this project id.

project_section_id.description: Move the task to this section id.

responsible_id.description: User id to assign, or 'author' for the token owner.

due_at.description: New due date and time, Unix milliseconds.

ended_at.description: Completion time, Unix milliseconds. Completes the task.

tools.title: Add a comment to a task
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to a task. Visible to people who can see the task. Not retried on failure. API: POST /comments.
